# v1.4.20 - Pause and resume auto-scroll

- Added: a pause/play button inside the floating auto-scroll pill, so you can
  stop the page from scrolling without leaving auto-scroll mode.
- Added: while paused the pill stays visible and the button switches to the
  play icon, so tapping it again continues from where you stopped at the same
  speed.
- Note: turning auto-scroll off still hides the pill as before; pausing only
  freezes the scrolling in place.
